{{Quote|Patch me through to that sergeant.|Stavin Thaal|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] on a [[Hunt for Stavin Thaal|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], the leader and founder of the Pop-Dogs. After escaping from [[Glitterby Base]], which was under Pop-Dog control, the Wraiths took refuge in the [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]], where they were [[Siege of Mount Lyss Meteorological station|besieged]] by the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK" />

The sergeant was among a group of troopers that ascended the mountain after the Wraiths' escape. Upon reaching a narrow chamber, he and the other troopers found the [[Death/Legends|dead]] body of [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Bhindi Drayson]], whose upper body was covered by a body cloak. After removing the cloak, they found a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] face with its [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] closed and wearing a cheerful smile. Unbeknownst to the troopers, Drayson was outfitted with a [[neoglith masquer]] to conceal her identity. Meanwhile, Thaal and other Pop-Dogs officers monitored the siege from a command center through multiple views from the troopers' helmet [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]]. Thaal instructed his [[Unidentified Pop-Dog field coordinator|field coordinator]] to patch him directly through to the sergeant so he could issue orders. However, one of the troopers prodded Drayson's body with his toe, triggering the booby trap that the Wraiths had rigged beneath it. As the field coordinator successfully connected Thaal to the sergeant, the ensuing explosion killed the sergeant and the other troopers in the chamber.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pop-Dog sergeant was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
